verdict.rationale: Auth products of this kind could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so the question applies, but the evidence shows none. The hosted MCP docs server serves external AI clients rather than acting as a built-in assistant. "Agent delegation" refers to authorizing AI agents, not delegating tasks to an assistant inside Better Auth. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
